mentions.name: OSTEP × Redox kernel documentation series
mentions.description: A topic-by-topic documentation series that reads through the OSTEP operating systems book and documents how the real Redox kernel tackles each topic, having covered struct proc and scheduling so far, with memory management next.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am now reading through the excellent OSTEP book and documenting topic-by-topic how a real kernel (Redox) tackles the topic. I have covered struct proc and scheduling till now, the next is memory management! (https://himwant.org/series/ostep--redox/)
